scripts.test:ts: bun run build:packages && bun test packages/input-bindings/test/*.test.ts packages/input-bindings-runtime/test/*.test.ts packages/input-bindings-web/test/*.test.ts packages/input-bindings-react/test/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.build:pages: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd packages/input-bindings-demo build
scripts.test:storybook: bun run build:storybook && bun run test:storybook:built
scripts.test:pages: bun run build:pages && bun run test:pages:built
scripts.dist:git: bun run build:packages && bun run pack:packages && bun scripts/publish-git-dist.ts
scripts.check:fast: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.check: bun run check:fast && cargo fmt --all --check && bun run secrets:check && bun run test:unit && cargo test --locked --workspace --all-targets && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun run build
scripts.check:full: bun run check && bun run test:storybook && bun run test:pages
scripts.check:commit: bun run format:check && cargo fmt --all --check && bun run lint && bun run secrets:staged
scripts.check:push: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && cargo test --locked --workspace --all-targets
scripts.test:e2e: bun run test:storybook && bun run test:pages
